coverage.included: 3 populated records; inclusion is defined by the exact source locator in every row
coverage.omitted: Long-term longevity, other interventions, replication across health systems; no patient-level data
coverage.missingness: Unobserved or unpublished is not zero; omitted places/classes have no inferred values.

uncertainty: Mortality rates rounded; hazard ratio 95% CI 0.70–0.99. Intervention includes the clinical workflow, not an isolated model. Follow-up extended through 2022-07-31 according to the same-trial economic analysis. EHR ascertainment may miss deaths outside the hospital; censored patients were confirmed alive only through their most recent recorded visit.
